key_verdict: No disagreements; the setter's key is correct in all four parts.
why: Finding an unknown frequency from a given estimated mean, then the standard deviation, then one-pick and two-pick-without-replacement probabilities read off the same table is an established P2 shape in SEAB's own register (imperatives, 'Calculate an estimate of', the [2]/[2]/[1]/[3] split), the numbers are exam-clean (n = 60, mean exactly 50, sqrt(520), a 20-out-of-60 tail) and the vehicle is no longer the 2024 P2 Q7(a) median-mean-SD-interpret sequence; the (c) pair shares the one-then-two selection structure of 2023 P2 Q7(b) but that is the genre, not a re-skin, since the context, the table and the 'exactly one' event are all different.
